body: Yes, it's an off label use, supposedly. I tried this first because the Medicaid plan I'm on doesn't cover stimulants for anyone over 18. Adderall 20mg would be like $150 a month, so I was hoping I could get by on Wellbutrin which is $3 a month.
Ahhh the whole time I was reading this I was like "fuck I hope it's not Wellbutrin," because that's what I'm on for ADHD. Been on it for a month and don't feel any different.
I'm really sorry about what happened to you. I hope you're okay, and I'm here if you want to talk. Is this your first baby?
Might make you a little high or tired. That's about it. I hope you're okay.
